raw.headline: Prioritize Usability, led by ads and post-update UI complaints, while watching Billing/support growth
raw.memo_markdown:
## Recommendation

Put next quarter's product effort into Usability, led by `usability/ads` and `usability/ui_layout`. Usability ranks first on severity_sum ({{C051}}) and first on complaint_count ({{C053}}), with a severity sum of {{C055}} across {{C054}} complaints. Its mean severity ({{C056}}) ranks fourth ({{C052}}), so the case rests on volume and total severity rather than intensity per complaint. Because Usability is first on the baseline priority measure, no override is needed.

## Evidence

`usability/ads` is the third-ranked issue overall ({{C015}}), with {{C011}} complaints. Reviewers describe ads that are too frequent and unrelated songs playing in ad breaks (`45e2aab4-449c-4c23-83d0-69bd568a9e08`, `92bd7ff4-4322-4406-9033-f13e3079aa74`). `usability/ui_layout` ranks sixth ({{C030}}), and reviewers say recent updates removed loop and shuffle features and made the app worse (`141bd2c2-8403-45b8-ae65-6e9cfa24270b`, `e7747485-42c5-4bb9-b1e2-1b4044eedb5a`). `usability/general` covers autoplay overriding song choices (`f7ead10f-db26-479f-b2d7-411c2804f044`).

## Recent trend

In the first matched period, Usability complaints were {{C091}}; in the later period they rose to {{C100}}, which is the highest of the four areas. Billing/support is the area whose complaints grew most among the four: they rose from {{C088}} to {{C097}}. Access moved from {{C087}} to {{C096}}, and Playback from {{C090}} to {{C099}}. The recommendation still holds on the later-period ranking, but Billing/support is closing in and deserves a dedicated track. Complaint share of classified records rose from {{C085}} to {{C094}}, and cancellation-intent records rose from {{C086}} to {{C095}}. These are observed changes; they are not attributed to any cause, and cancellation language is stated intent, not observed churn.

## Alternatives considered

Billing/support ranks second on complaint_count ({{C067}}) and third on severity_sum ({{C065}}). Its top issue, `billing/subscription_entitlement`, is second overall ({{C010}}), with reviewers objecting to features locked behind premium (`c917e047-2d4b-41c5-ad41-bc9355b6d6e4`). Playback ranks second on severity_sum ({{C058}}) and second on mean severity ({{C059}}), with a mean of {{C063}}. Its `playback/general` issue ranks fourth ({{C020}}), and reviewers report wrong or stalled audio (`557527a9-d504-4387-a2e5-47d80048747c`). Access ranks first on mean severity ({{C073}}, mean {{C077}}) but fourth on severity_sum ({{C072}}) with only {{C075}} complaints. Its `access/login_failure` issue ranks eighth ({{C040}}), though login failures are severe for affected users (`97be5642-eab6-45f4-9c08-3aa28cc8e8ac`, `663a93eb-c77a-4b86-a883-c98889ac5f11`).

## Limitations

Reviews are self-selected public app-store text and do not represent all users. {{C103}} records were quarantined for empty review text, and {{C104}} records remain unclassified. Of {{C101}} completed records, {{C102}} were complaint or cancellation records. Complaints outside the four areas total {{C079}}, mostly general dissatisfaction ({{C005}} rank), which is not an actionable area. Cancellation language is stated intent, not observed churn, and no revenue effect is estimated.
